From THE HEMP COALITION <www.thehempcoalition.org>
For Immediate Release
March 14, 2000
Vancouver, WA.

George Ives is a 40 year-old 100% disabled Veteran. He suffers from strokes, high blood pressure, degenerative disc disease, Bear's esophagus. His wife Georgia suffers from seizures, including grand mal. Neither of them has any criminal history and they both live off of Richard's Veteran's disability.

On Feb. 17 of this year, Clark/Scamania County Drug Task Force broke down the doors to their home and leveled the laser dots of their guns on the throats and chests of Richard and Georgia, as the Narcos ripped through their home. They found a total of 70 marijuana plants in a small personal grow operation that George was maintaining for their own medicinal use.

Police claimed they were acting on an anonymous tip.

Facing over $8,000 owed for medications and medical bills, they had found that marijuana greatly assisted them in managing their symptoms (Georgia now must rely on Tegritol, Depakote, and Neurontin to control her seizures).

Because the only doctor available to them was a V.A. doctor they were unable to obtain the state required medical note of referral, as federally paid physicians refuse to participate in I-692 for fear of federal reprisal.

The court date for Richard and Georgia is May 18. Richard served his country and now he is being persecuted for attempting to escape the pain and suffering that he and his wife experience because of their illness. In addition to the fact that there is no affordable healthcare in America, our sate and federal governments are targeting the elderly, sick and debilitated...those who cannot defend themselves by the usual costly methods.
See
AIDS and Medical Marijuana:
On World AIDS Day Why Is No One Talking About the Cheapest Way To Help The Most People?
Analysis By Richard Cowan

We cannot let another good couple bite the dust. They have both been charged with manufacture and possession.

They contacted a lawyer in their area, upon referral, who seemed uninterested as soon as he found out they had little money.

PLEASE: FORWARD THIS POST TO EVERY RELATED ORGANIZATION, NEWSGROUP, and INDIVIDUAL WHO NEEDS TO KNOW!! Don't let them feed the meatgrinder. Thanks
